factProposals.value: A Review Queue item is keyed on the Basecamp CommentId (exact submission version) and also carries MessageId (thread); re-processing the same CommentId returns the existing item, and a new CommentId on the same thread creates a separate item while the earlier one is kept.

Intake takes one raw comment row shaped like Basecamp_MessageBoards_MessageComments (comment_id, message_id, body, created_at); ids must be real positive integers and malformed rows are rejected and logged without creating an item.
If the comment source is unreachable, intake retries at most 3 times (connection/timeout errors only) and then raises a visible CommentSourceUnavailable; the Review Queue is left untouched.
Every intake outcome (marker detected, no marker, malformed row) emits one JSON log line to stdout carrying the exact comment_id and a correlation_id (taken from X-Correlation-ID when sent).
Some students request review with '##Please Critique##' instead of '##Critique##' (5 comments in the history extracts, 4 of which the original detector missed).

decisions.statement: Read comments through a CommentSource interface with a fixture implementation; the live SQL Server reader for Basecamp_MessageBoards_MessageComments is deferred.
decisions.rationale: No SQL Server credentials or approved driver dependency (pyodbc/pymssql) available; user chose to defer rather than add an untestable adapter.

decisions.statement: Store the Review Queue in memory behind a ReviewQueueStore interface for now.
decisions.rationale: Choosing a database is an escalation-level decision not yet made; the interface lets a durable store replace it without touching intake.

decisions.statement: Treat Basecamp ids strictly as integers (no coercion from booleans, strings or floats).
decisions.rationale: Lax parsing turned comment_id=True into 1, which could tie a review to the wrong submission version.

decisions.statement: '##Please Critique##' (any case/spacing) creates the review item like '##Critique##', flagged with a marker_note so the reviewer reminds the student to write ##Critique## next time; '#Critique#' and prose still do not count.
decisions.rationale: user decision, 2026-09-25: do not miss real review requests, but keep teaching the standard marker

limitations.statement: Review Queue items are lost when the process restarts (in-memory store only).
No live connection to SQL Server's Basecamp_MessageBoards_MessageComments yet; comments enter via HTTP (POST /basecamp/comments/process) or fixtures.
API routes, including the new intake and queue routes, have no authentication yet.
Malformed bodies sent over HTTP are rejected with 422 by FastAPI before intake runs, so they produce no intake log line (source-driven intake does log them).
